name: Token risk screen

description.model: Reads a token's safety screen: each check, its reason and evidence. Use when a Dive, Challenge or Zoom out weighs any token.
description.marketplace: Teaches the agent to read the platform's token safety screen (the simulated round trip, owner powers, upgradeability, liquidity, pool age, look-alike names and GoPlus) and what each finding means for a position. The screen is a guardrail the agent cannot override.

triggers: reading screen_token's checks for a token
deciding whether a token's control, liquidity or age allows a position
